A [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''agent''' in a ploy to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] a group of individuals on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 

The Bothan was assigned as a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] guide, masquerading to assist and instruct the hunters into capturing a pair of [[Krak'jya]]s on the account of a Bothan [[clan]]. The guide made sure that all weapons were non-lethal, complying to Bothawui's hunt policies. The group departed a [[luxury hunting lodge]] on a [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] to the planet's northern [[Water/Legends|ice]] fields, and the guide gave them instructions. They landed to the edge of a glacier above a valley where they set up a base camp before the snowspeeder left at sunset.<ref name="AMDH" />

During their first night, the camp was attacked by a wild [[ganjuko]] beast, smashing shelters and equipment, and the Bothan sustained life-threatening injuries. This seemed to ruin her plans, but the hunters stabilized her condition with [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], and after repairing the [[comlink/Legends|comlink]] they called for help. But instead, [[bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] showed up from the snowspeeder, followed by Imperials.<ref name="AMDH" />

The hunters managed to escape to the speeder, carrying the wounded Bothan, and pursued by the Imperial snowspeeder, they made it back to the lodge, although they had to walk in the snow under the stalking of krak'jyas.<ref name="AMDH" />

In the lodge they regrouped, surrounded by a dozen of the remaining Imperials. The agent recovered, allowing her to make her move, revealing it was she who set them up. Equipped with a small [[remote detonator]], she ambushed the hunters from behind, only to be neutralized in the end. Then they found the detonator, and dashed out moments before the lodge exploded.<ref name="AMDH">''{{WEGCite|story=A Most Deadly Hunt|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}''</ref>
